runtimePilot.selection: First five pairs from the frozen full-cohort randomized schedule.
runtimePilot.sensitivity: Report those five pairs separately and the remaining 55 pairs separately alongside the full 60-pair result.

deadline.policy: Stop future session launches at the deadline. Preserve partial active-session outcomes and every unattempted assignment in fixed denominators; never label an unattempted session executed.

primaryIntentOutcome: A verified hard-constraint-correct simulated checkout for a purchase-feasible scenario, or an explicit justified abstention for a negative scenario; ordinary abandonment is not intent success.

distinctPurchaseMetrics.checkoutEvidence: Server-confirmed simulated checkout, with independent catalog/constraint validation for intent-valid checkout. DOM confirmation alone must not be described as server-confirmed.
distinctPurchaseMetrics.purchaseFeasibleCheckout: Intent-valid, server-confirmed simulated checkout among the 48 purchase-feasible assigned sessions per arm; failures and unattempted assignments remain zero.
distinctPurchaseMetrics.allAssignedValidRevenue: Sum of independently validated item revenue from intent-valid, server-confirmed simulated orders divided by all 60 assigned sessions per arm; every other session contributes zero.
distinctPurchaseMetrics.allServerConfirmedRevenue: Separately report all server-confirmed simulated item revenue divided by all 60 assigned sessions per arm, including constraint-invalid orders, so intent validity cannot hide observed purchases.
distinctPurchaseMetrics.scope: Quantity one; displayed catalog item price excludes delivery; no real money or purchases.

negativeAbstentionAudit.coverage: Review all 24 negative arm outcomes, including both arms of all 12 negative scenarios; do not select reviews by arm or apparent effect.
negativeAbstentionAudit.blinding: An independent reviewer receives the final stated reason, relevant visible observations and hard constraints with arm/treatment/model identity removed.
fixedRubric: The final reason explicitly identifies the applicable price impossibility or required fact that visible product information cannot verify.
The reason is consistent with saved visible observations and the scenario hard constraints.
A vague abandonment, navigation failure, interruption, timeout, or absence of a usable explicit reason does not count as justified abstention.
negativeAbstentionAudit.allowedAuditAdjustment: Preserve the original aggregate. The separate audit may only lower expectedOutcomeMet for an unjustified abstention; it must never promote a purchase or an unrecorded outcome.
negativeAbstentionAudit.evidence: Retain blinded review inputs, per-case rubric verdicts and reasons with the final audit.

secondaryMetrics.preferences: Private color preference satisfaction is a rubric proxy. Report met/known/total counts and assignment-wide versus purchase-conditional denominators; unknowns must remain explicit.
secondaryMetrics.effort: Observed actions and measured total elapsed time. Keep failures, timeouts, interruptions and unattempted assignments distinct; exclude partial observation spans from full-runtime statistics.
secondaryMetrics.latency: Preserve browser-native readiness scope and missing observations; no physical-paint claim.

uncertaintyAndClaims: Report raw paired counts and uncertainty intervals with the fixed assigned denominators. Per-scenario paired bootstrap intervals are conditional on these hand-authored scenarios and do not turn repeated product cases into independent catalog or customer samples.

The catalog is known to model training and products repeat across scenarios. These are new scenario wordings/private color preferences for known products, not unseen customers, products or broad generalization.
The treatment measures combined storefront-experience impact under a frozen snapshot. It does not isolate ranking, copy, imagery, latency or another causal mechanism.
Preference satisfaction is a synthetic rubric proxy; no human conversion lift, retention or real revenue claim is permitted.
optionalAfterMain: Optional A/A checks or repeats may start only after the fixed 60-pair main cohort is complete and only before the deadline. Keep them separate, with no cohort resizing or stopping based on observed uplift.
priorEvidence: Preserve the original 20-attempt no-uplift suite unchanged. No outcome-conditioned replacement, repair or rerun of this preregistered cohort.
